outcome: Comparison of classification systems for cesarean deliveries (indication-based, Robson's, and hybrid model)
cohort: 1462 women who delivered at Nalanda Medical College, Patna, India, between January 2016 and May 2016
finding: A hybrid model combining Robson's classification and indications for cesarean section was found to be the most comprehensive system for classifying cesarean deliveries in a low-resource setting.
